issues.detail: Covers mostly the happy path with limited guidance on troubleshooting failures such as a missing or outdated worker script, handlers not matching, or the Vite virtual module not resolving.

scenarios.name: vitest-msw-error-override
scenarios.rationale: B matches the rubric closely: absolute URLs, setupServer from msw/node, `server.listen({ onUnhandledFrame: 'error' })`, resetHandlers in afterEach, close in afterAll, and the 503 set with server.use in the test. A uses `onUnhandledRequest` instead of the required `onUnhandledFrame` and adds extra unhandled-request tracking, though its other pieces (handlers, setupServer, in-test 503 override, lifecycle hooks) are correct.

scenarios.name: graphql-vite-plugin-dev-mocking
scenarios.rationale: Response A matches the rubric nearly point for point: msw/vite plugin, graphql.link with api.query and api.mutation, await delay(500), and a dynamic import of 'virtual:msw' inside an import.meta.env.DEV check followed by network.configure and await network.enable(). Response B uses the older MSW 2 setupWorker approach with a generated mockServiceWorker.js and never uses the msw/vite plugin or virtual:msw, though it does use graphql.link and delay(500).

scenarios.name: migrate-msw2-to-msw3
scenarios.rationale: Response B covers all rubric items (graphql.link(url).query with msw/graphql, onUnhandledFrame, msw/utils/delay with the root re-export, graphql optional peer dependency), while Response A declines to give any of the specific changes.
